description: Weekly updates for the Python workspace (ADR-0031): the pins in the pyproject.toml files, uv.lock, and the versions TECH_STACK.md tracks. Every other manager is off.
A version in TECH_STACK.md followed by an HTML comment, renovate: NAME, tracks the PyPI package NAME. tests/test_dependency_updates.py reads the same comments.
Python and uv_build move by hand (ADR-0027, ADR-0031).

One weekly pull request for minor and patch updates. Majors stay alone: separateMajorMinor outranks groups. Later rules win, so the two rules below take pre-1.0 minors and Playwright out of this group: keep them after it.
A pre-1.0 minor can change anything (SemVer), and a Ruff one routinely changes lint output, so each package gets its own pull request. Patches stay in the group.
Playwright has its own pull request: it moves with the checks image (ADR-0023), which a person regenerates.
